intent: CI fix: cross-platform absolute paths in validator tests + patch resolver in hook-wrapper test
notes: `800a2d7` (the v2.10.0 bump) pushed dev, source-ci ran run `33262093184`, Windows cells green, both Ubuntu cells (py3.9 + py3.13) FAILED with 3 tests. All failures traced to my Windows-only path assumptions leaking through nominal cross-platform tests.

**Cause 1**: `test_spaced_absolute_returns_spaced_path` and `test_missing_file_returns_file_not_found` in `TestValidateLauncherCandidate` used hardcoded `C:/Users/John Doe/...` and `C:/nonexistent/...` strings. On Linux, `os.path.isabs("C:/...")` returns False (drive letter isn't a Linux absolute prefix), so the validator returned `relative-path` before reaching the spaces or exists check. My in-flight attempt at `/tmp/John Doe/...` (POSIX-absolute) failed on Windows Python 3.13, which tightened `os.path.isabs` — drive-less rooted paths are no longer absolute on Windows py3.13+.

**Fix 1**: use `tmp_path` fixture to get a platform-native absolute prefix, then compose with `"with space"` subdir + `"py.exe"` (spaced test) or `"does-not-exist" / "py.exe"` (missing-file test). Deliberately don't create the file — validator's check order is absolute → basename → spaces → exists, so both tests hit their intended assertion before the exists check.

**Cause 2**: `TestBuildGitHookWrappers::test_windows_platform_shebang` patched `os.name` to `"nt"` but the resolver internally calls real `os.path.isabs`/`os.path.isfile`/`os.path.expandvars` — those helpers don't honor the patched `os.name`, so `C:\Windows\py.exe` fails `os.path.isabs` on Linux CI and the resolver returned `degraded`, propagating `HookShebangUnresolvable` up through the wrapper.

**Fix 2**: patch `gator_core.resolve_python_launcher_for_hooks` directly (via `patch.object`) to return a synthesized `resolved` result. Skirts the entire platform-conditional path-check chain — the test was always about "wrapper emits `#!<path> -3`", not about the resolver's internal probes. TestHookShebang's other tests already patch the resolver seam this way; this brings TestBuildGitHookWrappers into the same pattern.
Local re-verify after the fixes: `test_gator_core.py` + `test_hooks.py` = 144/144. Full sweep pending after Windows-side reruns land, but the three Ubuntu regressions should be resolved.
Rides the v2.10.0 release train; nothing tagged yet, so this is just an additional commit — no reset needed.
